title: Kaṇṇinuṇ Siruttāmbu
body: Madhurakavi composed the Kaṇṇinuṇ Siruttāmbu, a short prabandham of only eleven verses in praise of Nammāzhwār, which holds a central place in the tradition. Madhurakavi carried the music of Nammāzhwār's verses far and wide. It is said that in those days everyone, whether boatman, trader, chieftain or brāhmaṇa, attained a transcendent state simply by singing them.
